method: Front-face rasterization of actual decoded exported Skin and shorts triangles under exact captured Three bone matrices/camera at390x844. Per-leg comparison excludes arm/hand source triangles and opposite-leg silhouette overlap. Perspective-correct source restY restricts Skin witnesses to.615-.667m, with core threshold.625m. Count Skin nearer camera than same-leg shorts by>1mm. Lower exposed legs below shorts source hem are excluded.
limitations: Camera-visible same-leg silhouette diagnostic, not full 3D collision or full PBR render.
Depth rays can detect legitimate self-overlap where the same thigh bends across its own shorts silhouette; actual action images decide severity.
Triangles are culled using production front-face material setting.
All upperleg Skin is the delivered clipped geometry, never hidden full anatomical reference.
Both LODs use identical captured pose/camera fixtures; far geometry diagnostic is not a separately captured far film.
